title: Money and Central Banking
dek: Of how money passed from stamped metal to a government's promise, and how lenders and rulers built the banks that keep it.

panels.label: Bankers Tell It
panels.text: Sound institutions, built by prudent men, gave nations stable money and cheap credit.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: Each new institution was a deal between a ruler who needed to borrow and lenders who wanted security. When the deal broke, the money did too.

panels.label: The Tour
panels.text: 12 stops on the Chronosphere globe, from Sardis to Washington, D.C..
